channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: I'm an American who moved to a small French village. I tried to adjust, but learned I wasn't built for country living.
item.description: My husband and I moved from a major city to a small French village. After two years, I accepted that the country wasn't a good fit for my lifestyle.

item.title: I'm parenting my kids differently from how I was raised. I don't want them to fear me, but instead trust me.
item.description: I chose open, honest conversations with my kids about sex, drugs, and mistakes, even when others judged my parenting style.

item.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Trump's Greenland push is about avoiding a 'hot war'
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said US annexation of Greenland is a national security strategy meant to avoid a future armed conflict.

item.title: They quit, traveled, and rethought their lives — meet the adults taking gap years
item.description: Extended time off can carry long-term costs — lower earnings, disrupted savings, slower compounding — but for some, the benefits outweigh the risks.

item.title: I'm a US Marine vet who trained with Ukrainians 20 years ago. Here's the secret to their combat success.
item.description: Troy Smothers was a USMC sergeant when he deployed to Ukraine in 2005. He now travels to Ukraine to help build unjammable, fiber-optic drones.

item.title: Patti Smith says turning 79 made one thing clear
item.description: "I am happy every day that I have an opportunity to do new work or find new work or you know, experience something, even nature," Patti Smith said.

item.title: Ford's CEO says making Red Bull's F1 engine taught him one thing about how to beat China at the car game
item.description: Ford CEO Jim Farley said Chinese cars are "really good," and working on the F1 engine and its software brings Ford closer to beating them.

item.title: Harvey's CEO explains his early tactic to get customers: telling lawyers how bad their arguments were
item.description: Harvey's CEO reveals the demo tactic that helped him win early customers for his legal AI startup: Going straight at lawyers' arguments.

item.title: A Meta product manager with no technical background says vibe coding gave him 'superpowers'
item.description: A Meta product manager says vibe coding is letting non-technical PMs ship features and work differently with engineers.

item.title: Russia is pushing to build 1,000 of its localized Iranian Shahed drones every day, Ukraine's military chief says
item.description: Oleksandr Syrskyi said that Russia is currently producing 404 Shaheds "of various types" per day.
